reason: Structural constraint `forall $.results: balanceAtCompletion >= 0` on `GET /transactions/public`. That field is written only by the seed generator (scripts/seedDataUtils.ts: `balanceAtCompletion: getFakeAmount()`); the backend does not set it when it creates a transaction (backend/database.ts, no match for the name), and no schema or serializer constrains its value. Transactions created inside the application do not carry the field in the public feed at all. Its non-negativity is therefore an incidental fact about the seed data, not a stable property of this endpoint in the pinned version, which is the same reading as the other items of class D ($.balance >= 0, isRead == false). All 12 model calls for this item returned no label (finish_reason=length), so this one was decided by the authors.
